```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggpubr)
library(emmeans)
library(patchwork)
library(broom)
library(vegan)

dir.create(here("0.-Diet_group", "Results", "Plots"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


# Set plot themes

```{r theme plot}
diet_colors <- c(
  "Omnivore"   = "#2864A5",
  "Vegetarian" = "#9C3F90",
  "Vegan"      = "#B36B32")
```


# Load data

```{r load data}
metadata <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "metadata.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(log10_depth = log10(reads))
arg_metrics <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "arg_metrics.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

# Alpha diversity models

```{r alpha df}
alpha_df <- metadata %>%
  inner_join(arg_metrics, by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(diet_group = factor(diet_group, levels = c("Omnivore",
                                                    "Vegetarian",
                                                    "Vegan")),
         sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")))
```

Covariates used in every part of the project: sex + age + BMI + log10 sequencing depth
(GPH_97 has no BMI and is dropped from the models).

```{r set models and covariates}

model_load <- lm(log_ARG_load ~ diet_group + sex + age + bmi + log10_depth, data = alpha_df)

model_simpson <- lm(simpson ~ diet_group + sex + age + bmi + log10_depth, data = alpha_df)

model_richness <- glm(richness ~ diet_group + sex + age + bmi + log10_depth,
                      family = poisson(link ="log"),
                      data = alpha_df)
```


```{r check dispersion}
dispersion_richness <- sum(residuals(model_richness,
                                     type = "pearson")^2) / df.residual(model_richness)
cat("Dispersion for richness data is :",dispersion_richness)
if (dispersion_richness > 1.5) {
  cat("\nOverdispersion: refit richness with a negative binomial model")
} else {
  cat("\nDispersion close to 1: Poisson is adequate")
}
```
# Marginal means estimation and comparison

```{r estimated marginal means}

estimate_load <- emmeans(model_load, ~ diet_group) %>%
  confint(level = 0.95) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  transmute(diet_group,
            estimate = emmean,
            conf_low = lower.CL,
            conf_high = upper.CL)


estimate_simpson <- emmeans(model_simpson, ~ diet_group) %>%
  confint(level = 0.95) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  transmute(diet_group,
            estimate = emmean,
            conf_low = lower.CL,
            conf_high = upper.CL)


estimate_richness <- emmeans(model_richness, ~ diet_group,
                             type = "response") %>%
  confint(level = 0.95) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  transmute(diet_group,
            estimate = rate,
            conf_low = asymp.LCL,
            conf_high = asymp.UCL)
```

```{r estimation results}
cat("\nMean estimation for load:\n")
print(estimate_load)
cat("\nMean estimation for simpson:\n")
print(estimate_simpson)
cat("\nMean estimation for richness:\n")
print(estimate_richness)
```

Contrasts carry Tukey-adjusted p-values and 95 % confidence intervals (`summary(infer = TRUE)`), on the link
scale for load and Simpson and as ratios for richness.

```{r mean comparison}

comparison_load <- emmeans(model_load,
                           pairwise ~ diet_group,
                           type = "link",
                           adjust = "tukey")$contrasts %>%
  summary(infer = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename(conf_low = lower.CL, conf_high = upper.CL) %>%
  separate(contrast,
           into = c("group1", "group2"),
           sep = " - ") %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.value,
         p.signif = case_when(p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
                              p.adj < 0.01 ~ "**",
                              p.adj < 0.05 ~ "*",
                              TRUE ~ "ns"),
         y.position = max(estimate_load$conf_high) + 0.052 * row_number())


comparison_simpson <- emmeans(model_simpson,
                           pairwise ~ diet_group,
                           type = "link",
                           adjust = "tukey",)$contrasts %>%
  summary(infer = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename(conf_low = lower.CL, conf_high = upper.CL) %>%
  separate(contrast,
           into = c("group1", "group2"),
           sep = " - ") %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.value,
         p.signif = case_when(p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
                              p.adj < 0.01 ~ "**",
                              p.adj < 0.05 ~ "*",
                              TRUE ~ "ns"),
         y.position = max(estimate_simpson$conf_high) + 0.009 * row_number())



comparison_richness <- emmeans(model_richness,
                           pairwise ~ diet_group,
                           type = "response",
                           adjust = "tukey",)$contrasts %>%
  summary(infer = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename(conf_low = asymp.LCL, conf_high = asymp.UCL) %>%
  separate(contrast,
           into = c("group1", "group2"),
           sep = " / ") %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.value,
         p.signif = case_when(p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
                              p.adj < 0.01 ~ "**",
                              p.adj < 0.05 ~ "*",
                              TRUE ~ "ns"),
         y.position = max(estimate_richness$conf_high) + 0.052 * row_number())
```

```{r}
cat("\nMean comparison for load:\n")
print(comparison_load %>% select(-y.position)) 
cat("\nMean comparison for simpson:\n")
print(comparison_simpson %>% select(-y.position))
cat("\nMean comparison for richness:\n")
print(comparison_richness %>% select(-y.position))
cat("\n p-values adjusted by tukey\n")

```

# Depth: rarefied richness and the accumulation curve

ARG richness is the only outcome that depends on sequencing depth (Spearman 0.32 against reads). Depth spans
13.5 to 99 M read pairs and its median differs between diet groups (Kruskal below), so the diet contrast is
repeated on `richness_rarefied` (hit table thinned to the shallowest sample, `Data/Scripts/03`), which carries
no depth term. The accumulation curve shows how far from saturation the libraries are.

```{r depth}
cat("Sequencing depth by diet group (Kruskal p =",
    signif(kruskal.test(reads ~ diet_group, alpha_df)$p.value, 3), "):\n")
alpha_df %>%
  group_by(diet_group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), median_M = median(reads) / 1e6, min_M = min(reads) / 1e6, max_M = max(reads) / 1e6)

cat("\nSpearman richness vs depth:", round(cor(alpha_df$richness, alpha_df$reads, method = "spearman"), 3),
    "| rarefied richness vs depth:",
    round(cor(alpha_df$richness_rarefied, alpha_df$reads, method = "spearman"), 3), "\n")

alpha_df <- alpha_df %>% mutate(richness_rarefied_int = round(richness_rarefied))
model_richness_rarefied <- glm(richness_rarefied_int ~ diet_group + sex + age + bmi,
                               family = poisson(link = "log"), data = alpha_df)

comparison_richness_rarefied <- emmeans(model_richness_rarefied, pairwise ~ diet_group,
                                        type = "response", adjust = "tukey")$contrasts %>%
  summary(infer = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  separate(contrast, into = c("group1", "group2"), sep = " / ") %>%
  transmute(outcome = "ARG richness (rarefied)", group1, group2, estimate = ratio, SE,
            conf_low = asymp.LCL, conf_high = asymp.UCL, p.adj = p.value)

bind_rows(comparison_richness %>%
            transmute(outcome = "ARG richness (observed)", group1, group2, estimate = ratio, SE,
                      conf_low, conf_high, p.adj),
          comparison_richness_rarefied)
```

```{r accumulation curve, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 4.5}
cpm_gene <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "cpm_gene_GPH.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
hits_matrix <- cpm_gene %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene_family, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "cpm") %>%
  left_join(alpha_df %>% select(sample_id, reads, diet_group), by = "sample_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(reads)) %>%
  mutate(hits = round(cpm * reads / 1e6))

set.seed(1)
depths <- c(2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 13.5) * 1e6
accumulation <- map_dfr(depths, function(target) {
  hits_matrix %>%
    filter(reads >= target) %>%
    mutate(kept = rbinom(n(), hits, target / reads)) %>%
    group_by(sample_id, diet_group) %>%
    summarise(richness = sum(kept > 0), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(depth = target)
})

plot_accumulation <- accumulation %>%
  group_by(diet_group, depth) %>%
  summarise(mean_richness = mean(richness),
            se = sd(richness) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = depth / 1e6, y = mean_richness, colour = diet_group, fill = diet_group)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_richness - se, ymax = mean_richness + se), alpha = 0.2, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = diet_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diet_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Read pairs subsampled (millions)", y = "ARG genes detected",
       title = "ARG accumulation with sequencing depth",
       subtitle = "Mean with standard error; all 166 samples exceed 13.5 M") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "bottom")

plot_accumulation
```


# WHO critically important antimicrobials

The ARG metrics above count every ResFinder gene equally. This asks the same question for the gene families
that confer resistance to antimicrobials the WHO 2024 list places in its top tiers: CIA, HPCIA or authorized for
human use only ("WHO-critical"). HIA and IA are medically important too but are not counted here. "Highest
priority" in the column names means HPCIA or human use only; it is not a WHO category of its own.
Classification from `Data/Scripts/06`, with the same covariates as the main models.

```{r who critical}
who <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "arg_who_classification.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  distinct(gene_family, who_critical = family_who_critical, who_highest_priority = family_who_highest_priority)

who_cpm <- cpm_gene %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene_family, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "cpm") %>%
  inner_join(who, by = "gene_family") %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  summarise(critical_cpm = sum(cpm[who_critical]),
            critical_richness = sum(cpm > 0 & who_critical),
            highest_cpm = sum(cpm[who_highest_priority]),
            highest_richness = sum(cpm > 0 & who_highest_priority),
            .groups = "drop")

cat("Gene families classified:", nrow(who), "| WHO-critical:", sum(who$who_critical),
    "| highest priority:", sum(who$who_highest_priority), "\n")

who_df <- alpha_df %>% inner_join(who_cpm, by = "sample_id")
who_df %>%
  group_by(diet_group) %>%
  summarise(across(c(critical_cpm, critical_richness, highest_cpm, highest_richness), median))

who_outcomes <- tribble(
  ~outcome,            ~label,                          ~family,
  "critical_cpm",      "WHO-critical ARG load",         "gaussian",
  "critical_richness", "WHO-critical ARG richness",     "poisson",
  "highest_cpm",       "Highest-priority ARG load",     "gaussian",
  "highest_richness",  "Highest-priority ARG richness", "poisson")

fit_subset_models <- function(outcomes, data) {
  pmap(outcomes, function(outcome, label, family) {
    d <- data %>% mutate(y = if (family == "gaussian") log(.data[[outcome]] + 1) else .data[[outcome]])
    fit <- glm(y ~ diet_group + sex + age + bmi + log10_depth, data = d,
               family = if (family == "gaussian") gaussian() else poisson(link = "log"))
    contrasts <- emmeans(fit, pairwise ~ diet_group, type = if (family == "gaussian") "link" else "response",
                         adjust = "tukey")$contrasts %>%
      summary(infer = TRUE) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      transmute(outcome = label, contrast,
                estimate = if ("ratio" %in% names(.)) ratio else estimate,
                SE,
                conf_low = if ("asymp.LCL" %in% names(.)) asymp.LCL else lower.CL,
                conf_high = if ("asymp.UCL" %in% names(.)) asymp.UCL else upper.CL,
                p_adj = p.value)
    list(contrasts = contrasts, fit = fit, label = label)
  })
}

who_fits <- fit_subset_models(who_outcomes, who_df)
who_critical_by_diet <- map_dfr(who_fits, "contrasts") %>% as_tibble()

who_critical_by_diet %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>% print(n = Inf)
```

# MASTER CIA gene list (complementary classification)

The same models on the gene families of the CIA gene list used for the food-production resistome (MASTER,
Quijada et al. 2025; mapping in `Data/Scripts/06`). The list omits aminoglycoside, fosfomycin and rifampicin genes,
so it is a narrower set than WHO-critical, and it defines no highest-priority subset.

```{r master cia}
master <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "arg_family_master_cia.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(gene_family, master_cia = family_master_cia)

master_cpm <- cpm_gene %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene_family, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "cpm") %>%
  inner_join(master, by = "gene_family") %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  summarise(master_cia_cpm = sum(cpm[master_cia]),
            master_cia_richness = sum(cpm > 0 & master_cia),
            .groups = "drop")

cat("Detected gene families on the MASTER CIA list:",
    sum(master$master_cia[master$gene_family %in% cpm_gene$gene_family]), "of", nrow(cpm_gene), "\n")

master_df <- alpha_df %>% inner_join(master_cpm, by = "sample_id")
master_outcomes <- tribble(
  ~outcome,              ~label,                        ~family,
  "master_cia_cpm",      "MASTER CIA ARG load",         "gaussian",
  "master_cia_richness", "MASTER CIA ARG richness",     "poisson")

master_fits <- fit_subset_models(master_outcomes, master_df)
master_cia_by_diet <- map_dfr(master_fits, "contrasts") %>% as_tibble()
master_cia_by_diet %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>% print(n = Inf)
```

# Model diagnostics and descriptive summaries

Dispersion of every Poisson model (Pearson χ² / residual df) and the residual standard deviation of the Gaussian
ones, stored so that the choice of family can be checked against its model. Poisson is kept only below 1.5, the
rule of the dispersion check above; the message below flags any model above it.

```{r diagnostics}
pearson_dispersion <- function(fit) sum(residuals(fit, type = "pearson")^2) / df.residual(fit)

model_diagnostics <- bind_rows(
  tibble(outcome = "log ARG load", family = "gaussian", fit = list(model_load)),
  tibble(outcome = "ARG Simpson", family = "gaussian", fit = list(model_simpson)),
  tibble(outcome = "ARG richness", family = "poisson", fit = list(model_richness)),
  tibble(outcome = "ARG richness (rarefied)", family = "poisson", fit = list(model_richness_rarefied)),
  tibble(outcome = map_chr(c(who_fits, master_fits), "label"),
         family = c(who_outcomes$family, master_outcomes$family),
         fit = map(c(who_fits, master_fits), "fit"))) %>%
  mutate(n = map_int(fit, nobs),
         df_residual = map_int(fit, df.residual),
         pearson_dispersion = map2_dbl(fit, family, ~ if (.y == "poisson") pearson_dispersion(.x) else NA_real_),
         residual_sd = map2_dbl(fit, family, ~ if (.y == "gaussian") sigma(.x) else NA_real_)) %>%
  select(-fit)
model_diagnostics
over <- model_diagnostics %>% filter(pearson_dispersion > 1.5)
if (nrow(over) > 0) message("Poisson models with dispersion above 1.5: ", paste(over$outcome, collapse = ", "))

depth_correlation <- tibble(
  measure = c("ARG richness (observed)", "ARG richness (rarefied)"),
  spearman_rho = c(cor(alpha_df$richness, alpha_df$reads, method = "spearman"),
                   cor(alpha_df$richness_rarefied, alpha_df$reads, method = "spearman")),
  n = nrow(alpha_df),
  depth_kruskal_p = kruskal.test(reads ~ diet_group, alpha_df)$p.value)
depth_correlation

# Cohort and resistome summaries on all 166 participants (GPH_97 counts here; it has no BMI)
summarise_cohort <- function(d) {
  summarise(d, n = n(), n_women = sum(sex == "Female"), pct_women = mean(sex == "Female") * 100,
            age_median = median(age), age_min = min(age), age_max = max(age),
            bmi_median = median(bmi, na.rm = TRUE), n_bmi_missing = sum(is.na(bmi)),
            depth_median_M = median(reads) / 1e6, depth_min_M = min(reads) / 1e6, depth_max_M = max(reads) / 1e6,
            richness_median = median(richness), richness_min = min(richness), richness_max = max(richness))
}
cohort_summary <- bind_rows(alpha_df %>% summarise_cohort() %>% mutate(diet_group = "All"),
                            alpha_df %>% group_by(diet_group) %>% summarise_cohort() %>%
                              mutate(diet_group = as.character(diet_group))) %>%
  relocate(diet_group)
cohort_summary

who_all <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "arg_who_classification.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
resistome_summary <- tibble(
  families_in_database = n_distinct(who_all$gene_family),
  families_detected = nrow(cpm_gene),
  families_detected_who_critical = sum(who$who_critical[who$gene_family %in% cpm_gene$gene_family]),
  families_detected_master_cia = sum(master$master_cia[master$gene_family %in% cpm_gene$gene_family]))
resistome_summary
```

# Plot means

```{r p-value position funtion}
set_relative_pvalue_positions <- function(comparison_df,
                                          estimate_df,
                                          lower_padding = 0.50,
                                          bracket_start = 0.12,
                                          bracket_step = 0.10,
                                          upper_padding = 0.08) {
  data_min <- min(estimate_df$conf_low, na.rm = TRUE)

  data_max <- max(estimate_df$conf_high, na.rm = TRUE)

  data_range <- data_max - data_min

  if (!is.finite(data_range) || data_range == 0) {
    data_range <- abs(data_max) * 0.1
    if (data_range == 0) {
      data_range <- 1}}

  comparison_df <- comparison_df %>%
    mutate(y.position =data_max +
             data_range * bracket_start +
             data_range * bracket_step * (row_number() - 1))

  y_lower <- data_min - data_range * lower_padding

  y_upper <- max(comparison_df$y.position,
                 na.rm = TRUE) + data_range * upper_padding

  list(comparison = comparison_df,
    limits = c(y_lower, y_upper))}
```


```{r p-value positions}
load_positions <- set_relative_pvalue_positions(
  comparison_df = comparison_load,
  estimate_df = estimate_load
)

simpson_positions <- set_relative_pvalue_positions(
  comparison_df = comparison_simpson,
  estimate_df = estimate_simpson
)

richness_positions <- set_relative_pvalue_positions(
  comparison_df = comparison_richness,
  estimate_df = estimate_richness
)

comparison_load <- load_positions$comparison
comparison_simpson <- simpson_positions$comparison
comparison_richness <- richness_positions$comparison
```


```{r plot load, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
plot_object_load <- ggplot(estimate_load, aes(x = diet_group,

                     xmin = "group1",

                     bracket.size = 0.8,
                     tip.length = 0.01,

  coord_cartesian(ylim = load_positions$limits,
                  clip = "off") +

       x = NULL,

      r = 5,
      b = 5,
      l = 5))
plot_object_load
```

```{r plot simpson, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
                               size = 9),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold",
                                size = 9),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 8,
      r = 5,
      b = 5,
      l = 5))
plot_object_simpson
```

```{r plot richness, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
plot_object_richness <- ggplot(estimate_richness,aes(x = diet_group,
                                                     y = estimate,
                                                     colour = diet_group)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf_low,
                    ymax = conf_high),
                width = 0.12,
                linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = diet_colors,
                      guide = "none") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(comparison_richness,
                     xmin = "group1",
                     xmax = "group2",
                     y.position = "y.position",
                     label = "p.signif",
                     bracket.size = 0.8,
                     tip.length = 0.01,
                     size = 4) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = richness_positions$limits,
                  clip = "off") +
  labs(title = "ARG Richness",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Richness") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11,
                                  face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold",
                               colour = unname(diet_colors),
                               size = 9),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold",
                                size = 9),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5))
plot_object_richness
```

```{r final plot, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
plot_alpha <- (
  plot_object_load |
  plot_object_richness |
  plot_object_simpson
) +
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(1, 1, 1)
  )
plot_alpha
```
